summary: Injured climber on Pyramid Peak required an overnight rescue; SAR volunteers spent the night on a saddle at ~13,000 ft giving aid; a helicopter evacuation was observed the next morning
location: Pyramid Peak saddle (~13,000 ft), Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
notes: Thread titled Accident on Pyramid Fri/Sat 21/22 Aug 2015. Mechanism not stated in thread. An Aspen Journalism article (Anatomy of a rescue in the Hunter-Fryingpan Wilderness) was opened and verified to describe a different incident (July 2014), so it is NOT cited here. | 2026-09-15: 14ers.com forum link removed per site ban; replaced with Pitkin County Sheriff Office press release (8/22/2015) confirming 8/21/2015 Pyramid Peak night rescue, 55-yr-old Milwaukee climber 25-ft fall near summit, MRA teams overnighted at 13,030-ft saddle, HAATS Blackhawk extraction 8/22 morning.
